title: Night Raid on Mulan Valley
summary: Medusa tells Xiao Yan the leftover Fallen Heart Flame energy cannot hurt her yet, and he studies the seventh-tier Heaven Soul Blood Fusing Pill, which may bring on a pill calamity. Using an encampment map from Little Fairy Doctor, Xiao Yan crushes her jade signal and splits the attack: Medusa takes Yan Luo Tian in the north and he takes the Three Elders of Mulan in the west. Hai Bodong commands the Snakemen and Yan Alliance fighters waiting in ambush as backup. At night Xiao Yan slips into the Mulan camp, grabs Elder Hutou with the Sky Fire Three Mysterious Changes and kills him despite the other elders' threats. Mulan Valley Dou Huangs chase him with guerrilla tactics until he burns them with the Angry Buddha Lotus Flame. Medusa, already done with Yan Luo Tian, arrives to cover his escape from the last two elders.
